optimizedDescription.value: Shared registry and reconciler make transitions, archive, status, recovery, approvals, verification, effects, and progress use one validity model.

optimizedContext.value:
# Transition Checks

## Rules
### Check ABI and registry
- Stable IDs include `protocol.edge`, `workflow.requires`, `workflow.taskCompletion`, `deps.consistent`, `workspace.readOnly`, `impl.filesResolved`, `impl.linksInScope`, `verification.current`, `approval.spec`, `approval.signoff`, `schema.nameMatch`, `archive.archivable`, `spec.overlap`, `hook.pre`, `hook.post`; never `archive.publication`.
- Each `Check`: stable string `id`, short gerund `label`, explicit `kind: predicate|effect`, `execute(ctx): Promise<CheckResult>`. Result: id/label/kind/outcome `pass|fail|skip`, failure code/message, optional details. `instruction:` hooks are not checks.
- Application checks extend `WorkflowCheck` with pass/fail/skip helpers; named `create<Name>(deps)` takes only ports used by that check. Optional domain `run(facts)` is pure, never production I/O.
- No `PredicateSnapshots`, `needs`, `emptyPredicateSnapshots`, `gatherPredicateSnapshots`, or global fact gathering. One module pair per check. Runtime IDs remain plugin-safe strings.
- `CheckExecutionContext`: change, schema, transition attempt or archive operation, baked approval config, `skipHookPhases`, `allowOverlap`, `allowOutOfScope`, optional pure DAG status, `onCheckProgress`, per-evaluation `passMemo`. Task check memoizes `CountTasks` only in `passMemo`.
- Registry alone owns binding applicability `from`/`to`/`along` or operation. Effects also declare `phase: before-persist|after-persist`, `onFailure: abort|collect`, selector identity. No check-owned applicability or check-ID timing switches.

### Direction and evaluation
- `along`: `forward|backward|redesign|recovery|any`; recovery is only `archiving→archivable`, never backward. Redesign targets `designing`.
- Progress axis uses known states from `schema.workflow[]`, splicing omitted `ready, implementing, verifying, done, archivable, archiving` by `AXIS_FALLBACK` relative order. Unknown strings occupy no slot; omission never removes protocol state. `drafting`/`designing` absent from fallback.
- Transition: classify requested pair; never rewrite target for approvals. `TransitionChange` fail-fast on failed `protocol.edge`; `GetStatus` collects it with all matching predicates. Execute each matching predicate once; allowed iff none fail. Then run matching effects by slot around persistence.
- Archive is operation, not fake edge; never bind `approval.signoff`.
- Predicates determine projected allowance. Effects never affect status allowance; `--skip-hooks` skips effects only.
- Before-persist abort → `HookFailedError`, no persist. After-persist collect → record and continue. Same matcher selects predicates/effects.

### Canonical validity and reconciliation
- Pure shared evaluator consumes fresh change, schema, gates/policy, artifacts, confirmed implementation; independently reports artifact review, approvals, verification, task completion, state validity, blockers, affected inputs, reasons, recovery, next action.
- Recovery priority: stale/revoked required spec approval → `designing`; else stale/revoked sign-off for later change → `done`; stale verification blocks applicable boundaries at `verifying` or later and renews in place; else artifact drift follows `invalidation.workflow`, with `preserve` retaining state. Never advance earlier state.
- Unresolved non-task drift/review blocks applicable forward movement even with artifact policy `none`. Verification staleness does not block entry into `verifying`. Task presence, structure, completion evaluated live at configured boundaries and archive.
- Sole application owner `ReconcileChangeValidity` acquires fresh files, evaluates verdict, materializes artifact/approval/verification changes, appends audit, selects recovery, persists atomically. Delegators: `GetStatus`, `ValidateArtifacts`, `ApproveSpec`, `ApproveSignoff`, `TransitionChange`, `ArchiveChange`, `EditChange`, `InvalidateChange`, `StartVerification`, `CompleteVerification`, `InvalidateVerification`.
- Reconciler returns change, verdict, affected inputs, reasons, committed return; unchanged facts are idempotent. Reconcile again after hooks/mutations. Repository hydration, checks, CLI, skills never independently invalidate or recover.
- Typed use case exposes `execute`, canonical/config factories, `resolveReconcileChangeValidityDeps`; config factory normalizes args and delegates. Every mutating path must inject reconciler; missing dependency fails typed configuration, never falls back to `Change.invalidate`.

### Required bindings
- `protocol.edge`: every transition; `workflow.requires`: requested target; task completion from `requiresTaskCompletion`.
- `deps.consistent` and `workspace.readOnly`: enter `ready` and archive.
- `impl.filesResolved`/`impl.linksInScope`: target `verifying`, forward exit `implementing`, archive; explicit verification start reuses them through operation context, never fake self-transition.
- `verification.current`: `verifying→done`; requires completed successful current-fingerprint evidence. Active attempt cannot pass. Missing/unavailable/stale/legacy-unknown/mismatch/unresolved fails actionably; skip only canonical `not-required`, absent verdict fails closed. Label: `Checking verification freshness`.
- `approval.spec`: forward exit `ready`; disabled skips, only valid materialized current approval passes. `approval.signoff`: exact `done→archivable`; requires current valid sign-off and verification. Approval commands record consent separately; no happy-path pending states.
- Archive predicates include schema-name, archivable, overlap, shared workspace/dependency/implementation/validity/task/freshness checks. Publication remains private preflight.
- A matching check ID executes once even if multiple bindings match. After file/link-mutating pre-effects, reacquire facts and rerun readiness/verification predicates before persist. Protocol rejects `verifying→verifying`; verification start/complete are operations.
- `impl.linksInScope` alone is skippable via `--allow-out-of-scope`; attach `isSkippable`/`bypassFlag` only to that ID. `impl.filesResolved` never skippable.

### Effects and diagnostics
- Transition `hook.pre`: non-recovery, before-persist/abort. Transition `hook.post`: forward only, before-persist/abort. Archive pre: before-persist/abort; archive post: after-persist/collect; both use step `archiving`.
- Hook checks own `RunStepHooks` dependency. Skip selection uses binding phase plus target/source or archive pre/post identity; transition pre/post share before-persist.
- Fail messages explain actionable difference. Dependencies show extracted vs persisted per spec; overlap names peers/specs; readOnly names specs/workspaces. Implementation checks show count plus ≤3 labeled examples; full inventory only structured/dedicated listing.
- Generic progress envelope around every executed check: `check-start {id,label}`, optional `check-progress`, `check-done {id,label,outcome,reason?}`. Hooks map runner output into same bus. Status never streams; structured rows/blockers retain label/checkId.
- Canonical labels remain fixed per built-in ID; never `Executing:`.

### Projections
- `validTransitions`: protocol-legal targets. `availableTransitions`: predicate-allowed targets. `nextAction`: evaluation plus review blockers only.
- Implementing with complete tasks and allowed verifying recommends `/specd-verify`. Failed spec/sign-off approval recommends respective `specd changes approve` command. Backward skill hops remain available but not default.
- Historic parked approval states preserve approval-repair contract before protocol rejection. Production status/archive registry injects overlap detector; dependency-free default registry only isolated/non-production.

## Constraints
- No schema/task/platform result-array split; origin stays check metadata.
- Dry-run evaluates predicates only; schema YAML cannot list check IDs.
- Approval gates never route through pending states.
- Effect timing, failure, skipping, applicability come only from bindings.
- Adding checks/plugins cannot require lifecycle gather-logic changes.
